descriptions.zh-Hans: 在香港吃过蛋挞后写的菜单，暂定名字叫“黄色在中间”。
descriptions.en: A Hong Kong egg tart menu with the working title “Yellow in the Middle.”

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在香港尝过鸡蛋仔的记录，小鼓包还没数完，菜单已经有名字了。
descriptions.en: A menu from trying an egg waffle in Hong Kong. The title arrived before the puff count.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 等香港天星小轮时写的便签，“这一边”和“那一边”中间留着水面。
descriptions.en: My note from waiting for Hong Kong’s Star Ferry, with water between “this side” and “that side.”

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在香港吃鸡蛋仔后画的几排点，是自己的数数练习，不是做点心的模具。
descriptions.en: Rows of dots after an egg waffle in Hong Kong. My counting exercise, rather than a baking mould.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在太平山顶看天际线和海港后留下的线条，记着目光走过的小路。
descriptions.en: Three lines from looking over the skyline and harbour at The Peak, marking where my gaze wandered.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在香港和旅伴给纸上两岸编的招呼，一边出发，一边请对方慢慢来。
descriptions.en: An exchange invented with a traveler in Hong Kong: one paper shore sets off, the other says to take our time.
